双卡铃声
如何将音频文件设置为来电铃声、通知铃声、信息铃声或闹钟铃声？
如何为双卡设备分别设置不同的来电铃声和信息铃声？
如何在应用中集成铃声设置组件？
如何通过"我的铃声"按钮跳转到系统"声音与振动"设置页面？
铃声设置的最大时长限制是多少？
当你的应用需要为用户提供铃声设置功能时，应使用Ringtone Kit
它封装了将音频文件设置为各种类型铃声的完整流程，包括来电铃声、通知铃声、信息铃声和闹钟铃声，开发者无需了解底层音频系统细节即可快速集成
当你的应用需要支持双卡设备分别设置不同铃声，或者需要提供快捷跳转到系统铃声管理页面的功能时，Ringtone Kit提供了相应的组件和接口支持
把应用内下载的音频设置成系统来电铃声 / Set an in-app downloaded audio file as the system incoming call ringtone
实现自定义通知提示音设置入口 / Implement a custom notification sound setting entry
将录音文件保存并设为短信提示音 / Save a recorded audio file and set it as the message tone
接入闹钟铃声选择和设置流程 / Integrate alarm ringtone selection and setting flow
为双卡分别配置不同的电话铃声 / Configure different phone ringtones for dual SIM cards
为双卡分别设置不同的短信提示音 / Set different message tones for each SIM on dual-SIM devices
添加一键跳转到系统声音与振动页面 / Add one-tap navigation to the system Sounds & Vibration page
在设置页显示我的铃声按钮并跳转系统管理界面 / Show a My Ringtones button in settings and jump to the system management page
把本地音频文件注册为可用铃声资源 / Register a local audio file as an available ringtone resource
实现用户选择音频后直接设为通知铃声 / Let users pick an audio file and directly set it as the notification ringtone
管理来电铃声、通知铃声、短信铃声和闹钟铃声 / Manage call, notification, message, and alarm ringtones
集成系统铃声设置组件而不自己处理底层音频逻辑 / Integrate the system ringtone-setting component without handling low-level audio logic
do_not_use_when: 需求是分享文本、图片、视频或链接到其他应用或附近设备，并结合联系人推荐进行分发，应改用 share-kit / The task is to share text, images, videos, or links to other apps or nearby devices, with contact recommendations for delivery; use share-kit instead
需求是进行条形码或二维码的扫描、识别与生成，并处理暗光、模糊或曲面码场景，应改用 scan-kit / The requirement is to scan, recognize, or generate barcodes and QR codes, including low-light, blurry, or curved-code cases; use scan-kit instead
preconditions: 应用运行在支持该能力的 Phone 或 Tablet 上，且服务地区为中国大陆 / The app runs on a supported Phone or Tablet, and the service region is mainland China
待设置的音频资源可被应用访问且格式受系统支持，音频时长不超过5分钟 / The target audio resource is accessible to the app and in a system-supported format, with duration no longer than 5 minutes
若设置来电或信息铃声，设备需具备SIM卡槽；若按卡槽设置，目标卡槽在设备上有效 / For call or message ringtones, the device must have a SIM slot; if setting per-SIM, the target slot must be valid on the device
inputs: 音频文件URI或文件路径 / audio file URI or file path
铃声类型（来电、通知、信息、闹钟） / ringtone type (call, notification, message, alarm)
卡槽标识或SIM槽位编号（双卡场景） / slot identifier or SIM slot index (dual-SIM scenarios)
页面上下文或UI宿主对象（集成铃声设置组件时） / page context or UI host object (when integrating the ringtone setting component)
outputs: 已设置的来电铃声 / Configured incoming-call ringtone
已设置的通知铃声 / Configured notification ringtone
已设置的信息/短信铃声 / Configured message/SMS ringtone
已设置的闹钟铃声 / Configured alarm ringtone
双卡分别配置的来电铃声设置 / Per-SIM incoming-call ringtone settings
双卡分别配置的信息/短信铃声设置 / Per-SIM message/SMS ringtone settings
铃声设置结果（成功或失败及错误信息） / Ringtone setting result (success or failure with error information)
铃声设置组件界面 / Ringtone setting UI component
跳转到系统“声音与振动”页面的操作结果 / Navigation result to the system Sound & vibration settings page

postconditions.statement: 代码明确调用了铃声服务相关API或集成了铃声设置组件，并将目标音频与指定铃声类型关联 / The code explicitly calls ringtone service APIs or integrates the ringtone-setting component, associating the target audio with the specified ringtone type
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show use of ringtone-kit APIs or components to set a ringtone, with both the audio source and the ringtone type clearly specified?

postconditions.statement: 若为双卡场景，代码对目标SIM卡槽进行了显式指定，而不是模糊地设置全局来电/信息铃声 / For dual-SIM scenarios, the code explicitly targets the intended SIM slot rather than ambiguously setting a global call/message ringtone
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the requested scenario involves dual-SIM call or message ringtones, do the edits explicitly specify which SIM slot the ringtone is being applied to?

postconditions.statement: 代码未把录音、编解码、媒体会话控制或媒体库查询当作铃声设置的实现手段，职责划分正确 / The code does not misuse recording, codec, media-session control, or media-library querying as the implementation for ringtone setting; responsibilities are correctly separated
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is ringtone setting implemented with ringtone-kit rather than incorrectly substituting audio, codec, media-session, or media-library APIs for the core ringtone-setting action?
